how_to_steps: In Claude Code type /context and send it
Read the per-category table (system prompt, system tools, MCP tools, custom agents, memory files, skills, messages, free space)
Ask Claude: 'help me get rid of things that I am not using in this project'
Open the project's CLAUDE.md and trim it to under ~200 lines
